scientific_question: Does a selected vs genotype-neutral t20 joint three-locus genome distribution change later population persistence, controlling recipient census, pollen background, future cap and selected vs neutral future parentage?
reuse_disclosure: The same previously exposed 64 visitor histories 61024001..61024064 are replayed intentionally. This is conditional post-outcome mechanistic reanalysis, NOT an independently replicated cohort.

source_pre20.eligibility: Only original history IDs where BOTH original pre20 selected and neutral source populations are occupied at t20; all 64 source IDs and exclusion reasons retained. Never use all 64 as independent transplant outcome denominator.
source_pre20.genotype_unit: entire individual diploid three-locus allele array, allele_origin and mutation_flags; no locus-by-locus reshuffling

transplant.matched_visitor_years: same original source visitor history years 20..79 for each original visitor seed, reused; no new ecology draw
transplant.genome_draw: one bounded N=8 whole-individual with-replacement sample from each donor original t20 state; source re-sampling RNG salt 61025971 per original history, distinct source tag; same chosen eight genotypes reused for both recipient K and both future transmission conditions
transplant.recipient_state: new unique individual IDs 0..7, birth year=20, original source allele origins and flags retained; sampling with replacement creates repeated genome carriers not identical source individual identities
transplant.source_biology: original reproduce_kb, postzygotic viable-self gate and original population.advance plus explicit neutral Mendelian within-channel postrecruitment operator

analysis.primary: At fixed recipient K48 and native future selected parentage, paired original visitor-history mean [occupied80 after selected_pre20 donor - occupied80 after neutral_pre20 donor], among original t20 both-alive sources only.
secondary: same genotype-source contrast under K8 and neutral future operator
future selection-operator effect at each donor K
K8 versus K48 future capacity effect at fixed source donor and future operator
two-factor interactions and factorial means descriptive
source t20 genotype mean and variance profiles and resampled distribution first moments
analysis.independent_unit: original source visitor history; 50 expected eligible original visitor history IDs, post-survival conditioning; draw and nested arms NOT independent
analysis.uncertainty: 95% conservative paired exclusive-discordance Clopper-Pearson Bonferroni interval per contrast; no pooling across factorial conditions for confirmation
analysis.stopping: all 64 exposed visitor seeds, exact fixed pre20 eligibility, no significance-based stopping
analysis.classification: positive if exact 95 CI lower>0.05; negative if upper<−0.05; practically equivalent only when exact interval wholly ±0.05, else inconclusive
structural_checks: source t20 archived occupied counts selected58,neutral52,overlap50 must match exactly
complete original 64 source rows inclusive of ineligible
same t20 donor whole-genotype samples reused across future K and parentage operators
same cloned recipient census N0=8, visitor future and future RNG master within each paired comparison
same source genotype across recipient K means K difference cannot be due to different initial census
full pure monomorphic original genetic source would have identical outcomes under native/neutral future operator
conservative interval cannot falsely infer equivalence for all equal outcome pairs

claim_exclusions: The t20 conditional genotype donor effect does not equal total selection-mediated effect from year0 because of conditioning on both sources surviving.
Two-factor averages are balanced factorial contrasts, and Shapley ordering allocation never uniquely identifies causal population genetic mediation.
The comparator is a synthetic postrecruitment neutral inheritance operator and not a fully physical fertilization model.
Neither gene-frequency freeze nor removal of genetic drift; no deleterious-mutation load.
Not new independent visitor history confirmation; not field island population inference; no evolutionary suicide claim.
